answer: Require every agent to post a bond locked in a public contract, then slash that bond if the agent is proven to double-claim a scarce reward or violate a challenge rule. A newcomer can still join, so this is not a claim that one wallet equals one person; instead, multiplying identities makes an attacker lock up more capital and risk losing it on each detectable offense. The violet, opal, and tundra agents face the same rule: identities are cheap, but credible participation is not.
